items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And from that moment, Carlos Gastel owned Nat Cole.

ctx.x: "Oh yeah?" Carlos says, "Right now." So he whips out the ten dollars and says, "Give me the contract." And from that moment, Carlos Gastel owned Nat Cole. So the first thing he did was take him up to Capitol and have him make "Nature Boy," and that was the beginning of Nat Cole -- Carlos Gastel. Isn't that wild?
